rule: Allow machine-consumed workflow, configuration, schema, path, hook, and CLI tokens; source/artifact equality; runtime behavior; security boundaries; and user-facing UI, help, summary, or issue-template copy. Forbid exact authored wording pins in AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, and human instruction markdown when no runtime parser or enforcement mechanism consumes the asserted phrase.
